info.name: InvoiceEQ — Full API Collection (No Webhooks)
info.description:
Complete REST API Collection for InvoiceEQ (AP/AR Automation, ATLAS Intelligence, Chat, Trainer, Settings, Admin, Support, Billing, Connectors).

### How to Use:
1. Set `base_url` variable (`https://invoicellm.admsofttech.com` or `http://localhost:8000`).
2. Set `api_key` variable with your live key `inv_live_...` (from Settings -> Security).
3. Test `GET /api/settings/security/api-key/verify` in folder 02 to confirm your connection & permissions!
4. Run collection or test individual folders one by one.

*Note: On the live cloud domain (https://invoicellm.admsofttech.com), all routes go through the public gateway at `/api/...` (or `/api/v1/...` on localhost).*

variable.description: Base URL (production: https://invoicellm.admsofttech.com, local backend: http://localhost:8000)
API path prefix ('/api' for cloud domain https://invoicellm.admsofttech.com, '/api/v1' for direct backend localhost:8000)
Tenant API Key (inv_live_... for production, inv_test_... for sandbox)
Inbound Invoice UUID (auto-populated by GET/POST invoices)
Outbound Invoice UUID (auto-populated by GET/POST outbound invoices)
Invoice Batch UUID (auto-populated by upload / batches list)
Background Job UUID (auto-populated by invoice upload or chat)
Chat Message UUID (auto-populated by chat session messages)
Trainer Session UUID (auto-populated by trainer session creation)
ATLAS Line / Recommendation UUID (auto-populated by GET /atlas/lines)
Rule / Memory UUID (auto-populated by chat rules or ATLAS memory)
User ID / Clerk User Ref (for Admin user management)
